pr_title: tabledesc: check that table schema is compatible when starting LDR
pr_body:
The following checks are now made when creating a logical replication stream:

- Source and destination tables have same number of columns.
- Source and destination tables have the same column types and names.
  - As a corollary to the above, user-defined types are explicitly disallowed.
- Source and destination tables have the same CHECK constraints.
- Source and destination tables have UNIQUE indexes on the same columns.
- Destination table has no column families.
- Destination table has no columns that use a composite key encoding in the primary key.
- Destination table has no virtual columns that appear in an index.

The existing TestForeignKeyConstraints test already checks that we properly check for NOT VALID foreign keys when using 'validated' mode.

fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/129729
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/130905)

`TestRandomTables`  may start barking as it will probably generate random tables we cannot support. If you know you see quick ways to add options to their underlying table generators to prevent creating incompatible tables, that would be really great. otherwise, the test could retry table generation a couple times and skip if it cant create anything thats LDR compatible.

issue_context.title: crosscluster: validate that tables are compatible when creating a replication stream
issue_context.body:
See https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Wj-6lu7N4p3vPGJ9qDPBbu9Vu8haTpcZ4Z5cKzYTE7c/edit

When a stream is about to begin (i.e. during dist sql planning), we should add certain checks that the data associated with the in memory src descriptors will replicate nicely to the destination descriptors. This validation list is not exhaustive but could include:

- Table Level
  - Disallow Column families (to be removed for 24.3)
  - Not null columns in a column families (need staged mode to lift this restriction)
  - Foreign Keys must be unvalidated, if kv write path is used
  - Table Descriptor equivalency: for exampel, columns must match, unless an applier UDF is used, in which case, the user is on their own. 
- Database Level - No need for this in 24.3
  - Fully qualified table names must match (i.e. databaseName.schemaName.TableName). Maybe we can relax this in the future, but i don’t feel like being in this business. 
  - Table level checks above must pass.

Epic CRDB-38974

Jira issue: CRDB-41694

so you're saying that `Idential` returns false for 2 User defined types, even if they have same definition on source and destination?
correct. the internal type OIDs would need to match, and it's exceedingly unlikely they would match between two different clusters, even if the definitions were the same.

if we want to handle user-defined types for LDR, then in the if statement right above this one, we could make a separate check that the UDT definitions are equivalent, so we avoid using `Identical` for them.
